sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def pix(L,ch): return sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(L)) for j in range(len(L[i])) if L[i][j]==ch)
def dots(L):
    return [p for p in pix(L,'W') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63]
def crows(L):
    ps=[p for p in pix(L,'c') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63]
    return (min(p[0] for p in ps), max(p[0] for p in ps), min(p[1] for p in ps), max(p[1] for p in ps))
def where(d):
    # classify dots: on divider (col 31), in charcoal, in black
    cols=set(j for i,j in d)
    if cols=={31}: return 'divider'
    if all(j<31 for j in cols): return 'charcoal'
    if all(j>31 for j in cols): return 'black'
    return 'mixed'
# step 1: SPACE to cycle selection
action(['SPACE'])
L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
w = where(dots(L)); print("after SPACE1:", w, crows(L))
if w != 'charcoal':
    action(['SPACE'])
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    w = where(dots(L)); print("after SPACE2:", w, crows(L))
# now DOWN probe (charcoal should be selected)
action(['DOWN'])
L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
r = crows(L); print("after DOWN:", r)
moved = r[0] > 18
print("charcoal moved down:", moved, "by", r[0]-18 if moved else 0)
if moved:
    for k in range(3):
        action(['DOWN'])
        L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
        r = crows(L); print("DOWN",k+2,":",r)
        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
print("final result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def pix(L,ch): return sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(L)) for j in range(len(L[i])) if L[i][j]==ch)
def dots(L):
    return [p for p in pix(L,'W') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63]
def crows(L):
    ps=[p for p in pix(L,'c') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63]
    return (min(p[0] for p in ps), max(p[0] for p in ps), min(p[1] for p in ps), max(p[1] for p in ps))
def where(d):
    # classify dots: on divider (col 31), in charcoal, in black
    cols=set(j for i,j in d)
    if cols=={31}: return 'divider'
    if all(j<31 for j in cols): return 'charcoal'
    if all(j>31 for j in cols): return 'black'
    return 'mixed'
# step 1: SPACE to cycle selection
action(['SPACE'])
L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
w = where(dots(L)); print("after SPACE1:", w, crows(L))
if w != 'charcoal':
    action(['SPACE'])
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    w = where(dots(L)); print("after SPACE2:", w, crows(L))
# now DOWN probe (charcoal should be selected)
action(['DOWN'])
L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
r = crows(L); print("after DOWN:", r)
moved = r[0] > 18
print("charcoal moved down:", moved, "by", r[0]-18 if moved else 0)
if moved:
    for k in range(3):
        action(['DOWN'])
        L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
        r = crows(L); print("DOWN",k+2,":",r)
        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
print("final result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
